definition: to plan or organize something
example: We arranged to meet after class.

definition: to use something that belongs to someone else and return it later
example: Can I borrow your dictionary for a minute?

definition: a decision between two or more possibilities
example: You have a choice between the train and the bus.

definition: to keep doing something without stopping
example: She continued reading after dinner.

definition: to say what someone or something is like
example: Could you describe the place you visited?

definition: to become better or make something better
example: He practises every day to improve his English.

definition: the act of travelling from one place to another
example: The journey took three hours by train.

definition: showing good manners and respect
example: It is polite to say thank you after a meal.

definition: ready to be used or easy to get
example: Fresh fruit is available at the market.

definition: to stay away from someone or something
example: We left early to avoid the traffic.

definition: a good or helpful result
example: One benefit of walking is that it costs nothing.

definition: something difficult that tests your ability
example: Learning a new language can be a challenge.

definition: to share information or ideas with someone
example: We communicate with our team by email.

definition: the natural world around us
example: Small changes can help protect the environment.

definition: to like one thing more than another
example: I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.

definition: to suggest something as a good choice
example: My friend recommended this book to me.

definition: feeling sure about your ability or ideas
example: She felt confident before her presentation.

definition: a result of an action or decision
example: One consequence of the delay was missing the first talk.

definition: working well without wasting time or effort
example: The new system makes booking tickets more efficient.

definition: able to change or adapt easily
example: My manager is flexible about working hours.

definition: willing to give or share more than expected
example: It was generous of him to share his notes.

definition: able to do things without help
example: Living abroad taught her to become more independent.

definition: to keep something in good condition or at the same level
example: Regular practice helps you maintain your progress.

definition: a situation that makes it possible to do something
example: The course gave him an opportunity to meet new people.

definition: to make someone agree to do or believe something
example: They persuaded us to try the local food.

definition: able to be trusted or depended on
example: The train service is usually reliable.

definition: important or large enough to be noticed
example: The project made a significant difference to the community.

definition: right for a particular purpose or situation
example: This room is suitable for a small meeting.

definition: to change something to fit a new situation
example: We adapted the plan when the weather changed.

definition: not having one clear meaning
example: The instructions were ambiguous so we asked for an example.

definition: very interesting or convincing
example: She gave a compelling reason to support the proposal.

definition: to think carefully about something for a long time
example: He took a quiet walk to contemplate his next step.

definition: to communicate an idea or feeling
example: The photograph conveys a sense of calm.

definition: careful and intentional
example: Their deliberate choice helped avoid confusion.

definition: certain to happen and impossible to avoid
example: Some change is inevitable when a team grows.

definition: a particular way of thinking about or understanding something
example: Travel gave her a new perspective on everyday life.

definition: very great or having a strong effect
example: The story had a profound effect on its readers.

definition: small but important and not easy to notice
example: There was a subtle difference between the two colours.

definition: to grow or develop successfully
example: Plants thrive when they have enough light and water.
